'''Kolvin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[General/Legends|general]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] as an officer of the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TIE" />

Stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], he tasked an Imperial spacer with infiltrating a complex and retrieving a [[Infinite Engine|machine]] created by the renowned [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]].<ref name="TIE" />
